title: Safer against abuse
functionalRequirements: Protect the service against abusive use

ambiguities.question: Which abuse: link spam and phishing targets, resource exhaustion by high request rates, or both?
ambiguities.proposedAssumption: Phishing and unsafe targets only; the existing per-IP create rate limit stays as it is.

ambiguities.question: Should abusive links be rejected at creation time, or detected and disabled afterwards?
ambiguities.proposedAssumption: Rejected at creation time; no background scanning.

ambiguities.question: Is an external reputation or blocklist service allowed?
ambiguities.proposedAssumption: No external services: only static checks on the URL itself.
